name: hyprland-display-arranger
title: Hyprland Display Arranger
description: Arrange Hyprland displays from the launcher. Reorder, position, and toggle displays; layouts persist across reboots.
author: kaareloun

commands.name: arrange-displays
commands.title: Arrange Displays
commands.subtitle: Hyprland external displays
commands.description: Reorder, position, enable, and disable displays. Changes apply instantly and persist to a managed Lua file.

preferences.name: managed-file
preferences.title: Managed Lua file
preferences.description: File the extension writes persistent display rules to (inside ~/.config/hypr).
